# x-twitter-scraper_activity (Data Source)

Reads 1 activity of your account by its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Activity ID. It is the id of an Activity log row and the last part of the dashboard's activity page URL.

### Read-Only

- `caller` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--caller))
- `charge` (Attributes) Credits charged for this activity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charge))
- `details` (Map of String) Fields of this kind of activity, such as its target. Each value is JSON text. Read it with `jsondecode`.
- `kind` (String) Kind of the activity. Only a signed-in dashboard session sees an `api_key` record.
- `object` (String)
- `related` (Attributes List) Up to 5 other activities on the same subject within 7 days, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--related))
- `request` (Attributes) The API request behind this activity. Null for activity from before Oct 30, 2026, and for activity no API request starts, such as a monitor event, a webhook delivery or a credit grant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--request))
- `request_id` (String) ID of the API request behind this activity.
- `status` (String)
- `timestamps` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timestamps))
- `type` (String) Type of the activity within its kind, the same as the type of its Activity log row. Examples are a write action type, an extraction tool type, a monitor change, a monitor event type or a ledger entry type.
- `url` (String) Dashboard page of this activity.

<a id="nestedatt--caller"></a>
### Nested Schema for `caller`

Read-Only:

- `api_key` (Attributes) Name and prefix of the API key used. Never its value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--caller--api_key))
- `auth_method` (String)
- `oauth_client` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--caller--oauth_client))
